sermon.title: Baptism's Role in Restoration - May 19 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: On a baptism Sunday the message explains what water baptism includes: confessing Jesus publicly, believing all His commandments are truth, and fully submerging in repentance. Baptism is burial with Christ and resurrection to new life, the sign of the new covenant as circumcision was for Abraham, and a commitment that God will give a tender new heart.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He corrects himself from “mark 4” to Mark 1:4. The recording places the message first and a worship set with a special song after it (~39:21).

faqs.question: Did Peter deny Christ again?
faqs.answer: No; that was the last time.

faqs.question: Why full immersion?
faqs.answer: We aren’t submerging just a hand or a foot, but our whole being.

faqs.question: What does repentance look like?
faqs.answer: Maybe we aborted children or mistreated family in the past, but now we don’t.

faqs.question: Does church position matter?
faqs.answer: No; rabbi, pastor or priest, we all must respond.

faqs.question: Is newness of life instant?
faqs.answer: It’s a long walk; keep at it and don’t be discouraged.

faqs.question: Will God kick me out for bad stuff?
faqs.answer: No, not right away; like a tree, you need to be growing.

faqs.question: What did the Ephesians do?
faqs.answer: They believed God over witchcraft and backed it up by burning the books.
